title: App-Server Daemon RPC Gate & Automated Rust-to-TS Schema Synchronization

claims.assertion: Agent daemons serving diverse clients (CLI, TUI, IDE) should enforce strict RPC wire protocols with automated cross-language type export to prevent wire drift

context: Maintaining multiple client interfaces (CLI, Web, VS Code, JetBrains) against a core agent daemon frequently results in silent schema drift and broken deserialization.
